blurb: Guests take narrated river cruises focusing on New Orleans history, enjoy live jazz music, themed events, and dining options aboard the Paddlewheeler Creole Queen. Cruises include visits to historic sites like the Chalmette Battlefield and feature meals such as Creole buffets and brunches. Special event cruises are offered for holidays like the 4th of July, Halloween, and Thanksgiving.
extraNote: Refund requests less than 24 hours prior to cruise departure will NOT be considered · Tickets are transferable and valid for up to one year · All reservations must be prepaid and are subject to availability · Cancellation requires 24 hours notice for full refund · Ticket booth adjacent to the Creole Queen
